descriptionRo: Organic conversion: full or phased conversion, the liquidity gap in the conversion years.

threshold.sourceRo: EU organic certification or a conversion contract with a certification body (README §6, category 6)

requiredDocs.labelRo: Offer / pro forma and technical data sheet of the investment (machinery for organic farming)
Contract with the certification body or the organic certificate
Nitrogen fertiliser invoices for the last 12 months

questionnaire.labelRo: Main crops and average yield (t/ha) over the last 3 years
How many hectares are you converting to organic farming?
In which year does the conversion start?
How much nitrogen fertiliser do you use now (kg N/ha)?
How do you till the soil?
Do you use cover crops or crop rotation?
Do you have sales contracts with organic processors or retailers?
In which months do you receive the most income?
What do you do with the old equipment and the waste (packaging, plastic film)?

options.labelRo: I keep it as a spare

dnsh.checkRo: No synthetic mineral nitrogen: the avoided N₂O emissions are quantified (kg N and t CO₂e).
Rotation and cover crops increase drought resilience; the climate risk of the parcels is known.
Organic fertilisation respects the limits in nitrate vulnerable zones.
The old equipment and the waste (packaging, plastic film) are handed over to an authorised collector or recovered.
The parcels are not in Natura 2000 areas, or there is an environmental approval; the conversion reduces pesticides.

yieldPctConversionYear1.sourceRo: Yield in the first conversion year, % of the conventional yield. Demo value from data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json (Product); to be confirmed against the current PNS/APIA rules

yieldPctConversionYear2.sourceRo: Yield in the second conversion year, % of the conventional yield. Demo value from data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json (Product); to be confirmed against the current PNS/APIA rules

yieldPctCertified.sourceRo: Organic yield after certification, % of the conventional yield. Demo value from data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json (Product); to be confirmed against the current PNS/APIA rules

organicPricePremiumPct.sourceRo: Organic price premium over the conventional price, after certification. Demo value from data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json (Product); to be confirmed against the current PNS/APIA rules

costEurPerHaConventional.sourceRo: Production costs per hectare, conventional farming. Demo value from data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json (Product); to be confirmed against the current PNS/APIA rules

costEurPerHaOrganic.sourceRo: Production costs per hectare, organic farming (includes organic fertilisation and certification). Demo value from data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json (Product); to be confirmed against the current PNS/APIA rules

conversionPaymentEurPerHa.sourceRo: Payment for conversion to organic farming, EUR/ha/yr in the conversion years. Demo value from data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json (Product); to be confirmed against the current PNS/APIA rules

maintenancePaymentEurPerHa.sourceRo: Payment for maintaining organic farming, EUR/ha/yr after certification. Demo value from data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json (Product); to be confirmed against the current PNS/APIA rules

cropPriceEurPerT.sourceRo: Conventional reference prices by crop, EUR/t. Demo values from data/demo/test-documents/farms/DEMO-0006.json; to be replaced with market prices on the day of the analysis

fertilizerNContentPct.sourceRo: Nitrogen content of ammonium nitrate (34% N), from the product name on the invoice

subsidyPaymentSharePct.sourceRo: Months in which APIA pays the organic payments, % of the annual payment. Demo simplification: an advance of up to 70% from 16 October and the balance by the end of the year; to be confirmed against the APIA calendar

apiaPrefinancingAdvancePct.sourceRo: Share of the annual subsidy (the current one plus the organic payments) advanced by the APIA pre-financing (F5), %. Demo value, to be confirmed with Raiffeisen (README §3, F5)

maxGraceMonths.sourceRo: README §13: grace period of up to 12 months, until the first harvest after the investment
